('Dial at Off', [{'label': 'Control 1 assigned at Off', 'actual': '', 'expected': 'X', 'cite': 'README 546 + human decision S20', 'passed': False}, {'label': 'Control 1 read-out after turning to Off',

rationale: S20: dial:draw() clamped self.value into [min, max] before comparing it with off_value, so a Trig Locks param whose Off (-1) lies below its range (off -1, min 0: Control 1 in the seeded config, 54 stock Digitakt params) drew an empty bar at Off, identical to value 0, and the 2-second read-out after turning to Off showed "0" while no CC was sent; the clamp also overwrote the dial's copy of the value with 0. draw() now clamps a local display copy, shows X when either the raw or the clamped value is Off, and never writes the copy back. S62: a MIDI device-config param without off_value (Off defaults to -1, README 546, param_manager.lua) reached the dial with off_value nil, so draw() treated 0 as the centre and -1 as a value: a half bar at Off and "-1" in the read-out. refresh_trig_locks now passes -1 for a MIDI param without off_value. n.b. (norns) params without off_value keep nil and are unchanged. The parameter values themselves were never changed; the regression shows no CC is sent at Off.
oracle: README 546: 'Setting a MIDI parameter to its configured Off value (default -1) ensures that the current setting on the device remains unchanged.' README 761: an Off lock sends no value. Human decision 2026-09-11 (S20/S62): the dial shows X at Off, a missing off_value meaning -1; Trig Probability (Off inside its range) and the norns params menu already show X.
collateral: Controlled lane, all passed with the fix: M-PARAM-001..046, M-PATCH-028, -036, -057, -058, -060..063, M-REC-PARAM-015..018, M-SETUP-001..003, M-SETUP-DEVICE-NAMES-001, M-SETUP-SYNTAKT-PEDALS-001, M-SETUP-UNREADABLE-CONFIG-001 (every M-PARAM-*, M-SETUP-* and every case requiring PARAM-OFF).
